item.title: Zahl 1.5
item.description:
Zahl 1.5 is about getting out of your way: a calmer window, quicker ways to move between sheets, and updates that arrive on their own.

A quieter window

  • The toolbar fades out while you type and comes back when you move the mouse. To keep it on screen, choose Sheet ▸ Always Show Toolbar (⌥⌘T).
  • Pick the toolbar you like in Settings ▸ Appearance: a floating capsule or a full-width bar.
  • No more scroll bar in the middle of the window. Scrolling works as before.

Moving between sheets

  • Press ⌘K, type a few letters of a sheet's name (or its initials) and press Return to jump to it.
  • Lots of sheets? Tabs that don't fit go into "more", and the sheet you're on always stays visible.
  • The Sheet menu shortcuts work again: ⌘T new sheet, ⌘⇧K clear, ⌘⇧R copy results, ⌘⇧E copy sheet with results.

Also new

  • Zahl now updates itself: it checks for new versions about once a day. To check right away, choose Zahl ▸ Check for Updates…
  • Try Zahl free for 7 days before entering a license key. Days left show as a small button in the toolbar.
  • Help ▸ Open Manual opens the manual on monokern.app.
